title: Arrangements in Allen's band and his four songs
summary: The band mostly used arrangements; he did his own recording with Russell's band and wrote only four songs.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: I wanted to ask you, who was doing arrangements for that band? Did you all have arrangements or did you all just -
When you recorded the records you made with that band -
The same way... Did you record any of your songs? Did you all work out any of the songs that you wrote?
No, not with him. I did my recording with the Louis Russell band.
You told us the first time we came that you had written four songs. Is that all that you've ever written?
Did you write any more than four songs? Is that all that were recorded or published?
No, but I mean, that was all, just four?
